name: hcapp_setHasherBlock
description: Blocks (1) or unblocks (0) another hasher for the caller: HC.HasherFriendMap (UserId=caller, Friend_UserId=target, Ignore). Every chat reader hides the blocked hasher's messages from the caller, no push from them reaches the caller, unread counts leave them out. Directional; the blocked hasher is told nothing. E9.F1.S16.

parameters.name: targetPublicHasherId
parameters.description: The other hasher's PUBLIC id (chat authorId)

rowsets.description: Auth failure returns the detail alone.

rowsets.name: BlockedHashers
rowsets.description: On success: the caller's blocked list, newest first (same shape as hcapp_getBlockedHashers). On failure: error detail — 1985 bad target/self/flag (errorType 2), 1986 unhandled (5).

columns.name: BlockedAt
columns.description: When the block was last set

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
